title: Circuit evaluation
statement: Given an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs, a circuit evaluates recursively: an input returns its assigned value, a constant returns its Boolean value, negation complements the subcircuit's value, conjunction returns true exactly when every circuit in its list evaluates to true, and disjunction returns true exactly when at least one circuit in its list evaluates to true.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs
